content.rendered:
SHS Bookkeeper
Christine Armstrong
carmstrong@sherwood.k12.or.us
503-825-6012

Sherwood High School can accept cash or check payments on-site and card payments via ParentVue and Payforit.net (lunch accounts).

Please ensure checks are made out to Sherwood High School (or SHS Band, SHS Key Club, SHS Think Pink, SHS Bowmen Pageant, etc.) and are written for the exact amount (check your student’s synergy account). Over-payment will result in a credit on your student’s Synergy account. Credits can be refunded later or applied to another fee on your student’s account. We do not issue cash to students for over-payment.

Please contact Christine Armstrong for account concerns, credits on your student’s account, etc.

Working together we can keep your student’s account at SHS current and accurate.

CHECKS SHOULD NOT BE MADE OUT TO STAFF OR COACHES.
